Dear All

Today was a great day. It was a bank holiday is South Africa so I decided to put away the charts and sped some quality time with the family. It is good just to chill sometimes. I'm humbled by the promotion and hope I can continue to help other as they have helped me, while I continue my learning. Now I need to get back to the charts as there is still much learning to do.

author: in2forex
text: Here is an update on my AU trade I took last week. I exited the trade early yesterday. The reasons for exiting the trade was as follows. 1) As I wasn't planning on trading the day I didn't want any open trades playing on my mind.. 2) We didn't break into the CPaz so I wasn't confident that price was going higher. 3) Although not great compression, it did look to me that price was compressed on the way up. 4) I was happy to take the profit, the one thing I've learnt at RTM is there is always another opportunity just around the corner.
